errorGroup.cleanedErrorMessage: Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed Locator: getByTestId('book-status') Expected: "200" Received: "401" Timeout: 10000ms Call log: - Expect "toHaveText" getByTestId('book-status') with timeout 10000ms - waiting for getByTestId('book-status'

steps.name: Execute the slots booking flow scenario including logging in and attempting to book the 09:30 slot.
errors: Booking status element reported 401 instead of the expected 200.

steps.name: Validate that the booking status indicator shows a successful status code of 200.
errors: Assertion failed because the booking status text remained 401 throughout the timeout period.

evidence.description: The assertion expects `getByTestId('book-status')` to have text `"200"`, but the DOM repeatedly shows `401`, indicating the application is consistently reporting a 401 status for the booking attempt.

The same check passed in a different region (eu-west-1) one second earlier, suggesting the test code is correct and that the failure is due to a transient or region-specific backend/authentication issue rather than a locator or assertion mistake.

The trace cannot be opened due to a Playwright version mismatch, so no additional client-side or network console errors can be inspected; this absence of extra evidence supports focusing on the clear 401 vs expected 200 status difference already surfaced in the error log.

analysis.rootCause: The booking flow returned an HTTP 401 (unauthorized) status where the test and application logic expect a successful booking status of 200, indicating that authentication or authorization for the booking request failed on the backend. This is likely due to an environment or credential/configuration issue rather than a problem in the Playwright test code, which has not changed since the last passing run one second earlier.
analysis.userImpact: Users attempting to book a slot are receiving an unauthorized (401) response instead of a successful booking, preventing the booking from being completed. This blocks confirmation of bookings for the slots-booking flow in at least some environments or regions.
